decisions.reason: Williams CDS 2024-25 not accessible via auto crawl (Cloudflare); peer pattern confirms LACs structurally suppress C11. Williams admissions page does not publish per-band GPA distribution.
Amherst IR explicitly states 'Amherst hasn't reported any GPA data for recently admitted cohorts.' CDS C11 intentionally left blank per institutional policy.
Swarthmore CDS 2024-25 C11 explicitly states 'High School GPA data is not available'. All bands 0.00%.
Pomona publishes 2024-25 CDS only as Tableau dashboard (no PDF). Public sources confirm 'Pomona does not report average GPA'. C11 not available in any band format.
Wellesley CDS 2024-25 C11 left blank — all three columns total 0.00%.
Bowdoin CDS 2024-25 C11 blank — all three columns total 0.00. Publishes C10 class rank but not C11 GPA distribution.
Middlebury CDS 2024-25 C11 left blank — all three columns total 0.00%.
Carleton CDS 2023-24 C11 blank (latest published cycle) — all three columns total 0.0%.
Northwestern CDS 2024-25 C11 marks every cell 'C or t' (Cannot Report / Trace) — explicitly suppressed by Northwestern enrollment office.
Harvey Mudd CDS 2024-25 C11 left blank — all three columns total 0.00.
Juilliard: audition-only admission; HS GPA not required nor used. No CDS published.
RISD: portfolio-based admission. Tableau dashboards only since 2017; does not publish CDS C11.
Berklee CDS 2024-25 C11 blank (0.00% all bands). C12 average also blank. Admission audition/portfolio based.
Cooper Union does not publish CDS. First-Year Profile has acceptance rate + demographics but no GPA distribution. Admission portfolio/competition-based.
Curtis Institute audition-only. Explicitly does not require HS GPA/rank/transcript. ~4.6% admit, ~26 students/year. No CDS.
SAIC: portfolio-based; does not publish CDS. Consumer Info has enrollment/diversity/graduation but no GPA distribution.
CalArts: portfolio/audition based across 6 schools. Does not publish CDS; Factbook has no admissions statistics.
NEC: audition-only. Does not publish CDS publicly.

Cal Poly SLO publishes CDS but it is a fillable PDF template with NO form-field values rendered for C11 (verified 2024-25 and 2023-24). Student profile page lists mid-50% weighted GPA 4.04-4.25 but doesn't map to standard 5-band 4.0-scale distribution.
ArtCenter CDS 2024-25 C11 blank (0.00% all bands). Only C12 reports avg HS GPA 3.84. Portfolio-based admission.
SCAD does not publish a public CDS. Office of IR has Fact Book but no CDS document.
MICA does not publish a public CDS. No CDS PDF discoverable on mica.edu IR pages or via web search.
CCA does not publish a public CDS. No CDS PDF found on cca.edu.

Claremont McKenna CDS 2023-24 C11 contains explicit refusal: 'High school GPA data is not reported. GPAs come in a variety of scales and can be difficult to standardize. Especially challenging with sizable international population.' All band cells blank.
Grinnell CDS 2023-24 C11 present but all 9 GPA bands blank; totals 0.00 across all columns. C9 test scores published but C11 not.
Hamilton CDS 2023-24 skips C11 entirely — table jumps from C10 (class rank) directly to C13 (application fee). No C11 rows in document.
Haverford CDS 2023-24 C11 present but all bands blank; totals 0.0%. C12 average also blank.
Washington and Lee CDS 2023-24 skips C11 entirely — jumps from C10 (class rank) to C13. No C11 section.
Rice CDS 2023-24 C11 explicitly marks every band as 'N/A' (all 9 GPA bands + C12 average). Rice does not report HS GPA distribution.
Bates CDS 2023-24 C11 present but all bands blank; totals 0.0%.
